speaker: P5191
text: When I went to class, I saw a strange figure sitting next to me.

speaker: P5192
text: That strange figure was very, very strange.

speaker: P5191
text: That strange figure had no facial features.

speaker: P5192
text: When I looked it in the eyes, it had a blank expression, almost scary-like.

speaker: P5191
text: It was tall, slender, and dark.

speaker: P5192
text: When class was over, I was walking to my car when all of a sudden,

speaker: P5191
text: The strange figure was immediately by my side.

speaker: P5192
text: startled, I looked at it in its face and said, hello? But there was no response.

speaker: P5191
text: It only proceeded to point down and make me look at something I'd never want to see again.

speaker: P5192
text: I looked down and I saw The crustiest, the dustiest, the dirtiest of toes.

speaker: P5191
text: These toes were something straight out of a horror film. They were long, uncapped, dirty, and very, very smelly.

speaker: P5192
text: Almost chimerical. And as I looked slowly into its eyes one more time, it pointed right past my head to look.

speaker: P5191
text: As I slowly with fear turned around to look at what it was pointing at. It was a prank and slapped me in the back of the head.

speaker: P5192
text: I turned around and the figure was gone.

speaker: P5191
text: After that experience, I drove home and that night I couldn't keep it out of my head.

speaker: P5192
text: As I was driving home, I looked in the rear view mirror and I saw a figure walking.

speaker: P5191
text: When I looked in the rearview mirror and saw it walking, a scared feeling rushed through my body.

speaker: P5192
text: My heart was pounding as I did one more glance and it was gone. Not knowing what to do, I looked behind me and in the back seat.

speaker: P5191
text: There was nothing. And that night, I was with my girlfriend. And as we were getting busy, and she proceeded to change, it was the strange figure. The end.
